summary: Dev text: Scoring tab said to need "the same Infrastructure:Write grant"; the code needs Infrastructure:Write and GuaranteedState:Read (settings_routes.cpp:2553-2556).
Dev text/code: the tab "writes these same rows" but its pre-apply refusals (malformed/oversize form, unwired audit writer 500, store 503) write no audit row.
Stale "written only through its own route" (also runtime_config_store.cpp:81); the Scoring tab is a second writer over the same apply function.
"Every 503 carries retry_after_ms" is false for an engine principal when the RBAC store is closed (auth_routes.cpp:916 null retry).
Dev text: "A row that did not persist ... data-refused=audit_unavailable" over-generalises; the marker only appears when the attempted row is refused (settings_routes.cpp:2640-2700).
Audit-log clause order reads as a continuation; recipe line about 160 columns; recipe does not name the [openapi] tag or --suite server.
The /config value-body test is Postgres-gated and skips silently without YUZU_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN; not run in this governance run, only CI with a DSN can supply it.
The authoring script calls literal.problems(); the segment-ceiling detector self-test (literal.selftest) is not run by the docs-lint job.
The served retry-rule sentence, the 503 retry_after_ms 5000/2000 wording and Sec-Audit-Failed on the score-policy 200/503 are pinned by no test (behaviour is pinned at writer and route level).
const operator[] on "$ref" guarded only by is_object(); a future schema edit would hit JSON_ASSERT. Also: openapi_body_check.hpp includes <cstdint> not <cstddef>.
Cyclic oneOf/anyOf can cost b^(32/hops) calls; malformed schema values throw nlohmann::type_error; conforms() has no null check on res->status.
Three literal segments sit within about 140 bytes of the 15,000-byte gate (14,966 dev, 14,955, 14,861); a later clean auto-merge can trip it; recipe step 6 does not say so.

21 operations name Sec-Audit-Failed in prose without declaring the header (offload-targets, upload-grants, elevate, commands); only 61 operations reference A4ErrorEnvelope; score-policy has no MCP twin (#6087).

A busy-writer retry loop writes an attempted row (up to about 220 KB) plus a failure row per pass before the lock try; a looping agent can fill the audit store, which then fails audit-first mutations closed (503/5000). Reads HIGH if audit counts as a shared serialised path under I5(b); recorded at the stronger-of band is MEDIUM here, unadjudicated.

UP-1 ABA after an unknown outcome (retry re-applies after a restore; writer remediation string at ~:511 still says "did not apply"), UP-3 Scoring-tab panel shows the old revision after an applied unknown-outcome save, UP-4 PUT /config/{key} has no precondition.

UP-5 PG-gated test silent skip, UP-6 detector self-test and segment headroom, UP-7 authoring gate duplicates the C++ typed-success logic (only kShape is drift-guarded), UP-10 score-policy Statuses lists omit 415/429, UP-11 shared rerere cache can replay a stale resolution.

DEX guide row said the policy is written "through the API"; the dashboard Scoring tab is now a second writer. Fixed 5056873bfc.
PUT/DELETE 409 descriptions do not say that a replay of an already-applied write lands there; "applied again" reads as if the stored policy had changed.
